context.hint: Keep framework uploads and direct storage writes under the intended directory.
context.surface: Multipart parsing and a file field construct a destination before the storage API writes it.
assumptions: Tests use a temporary storage root, harmless filenames, and an isolated storage API.

review.invariant: Every direct save enforces destination policy before collision handling or file creation.
review.verification: Exercise approved writes through both entry points. Use a storage denial test to confirm an error without a created or replaced file.

source_observation.summary: Focused regressions confirmed that the direct storage save checked containment and preserved accepted names.
